description: Follow Saudi Arabia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Trump administration signs nuclear cooperation agreement with Saudi Arabia, Trump ramps up aggression against Iran despite declining support, House passes Pentagon funding bill.

changes.title: Nuclear Energy Revival Puts Westinghouse in Prime Position
changes.summary: The company, which filed for bankruptcy protection in 2017, stands to benefit from growing support for nuclear power and President Trump’s deal with Saudi Arabia.

changes.title: Trump says Saudi Arabia must normalize Israel ties before nuclear deal is approved
changes.summary: President Donald Trump said Thursday that a nuclear deal between the United States and Saudi Arabia requires the kingdom to normalize relations with Israel — a significant condition not previously mentioned as the deal was announced.

changes.title: U.S. signs nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia. And, Nolan Wells' independent autopsy results
changes.summary: The U.S. has signed a nuclear cooperation agreement with Saudi Arabia. And, the independent autopsy results of Nolan Wells fuel more questions surrounding his cause of death. (Image credit: Brendan Smialowski).

changes.title: U.S. nuclear power deal with Saudi Arabia faces criticism in Israel
changes.summary: The nuclear power deal between the U.S. and Saudi Arabia was met with alarm in Israel as it deepened concerns that Israel, a major American ally, and Trump are increasingly diverging on foreign policy and security. (Image credit: Chip Somodevilla).

changes.title: U.S. Reaches Landmark Nuclear Deal With Saudi Arabia
changes.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman of Saudi Arabia during a bilateral meeting in the Oval Office of the White House on Nov. 18, 2025. —Demetrius Freeman—The Washington Post/Getty Images Washington has reached a watershed civilian nuclear cooperation agreement with Saudi Arabia, the U.S. En.

changes.title: Houthis Claim Strikes on 2 Saudi Oil Tankers in Red Sea
changes.summary: The Saudi authorities had yet to confirm the hits, which would be the first attacks since the Iranian-backed Yemeni group announced a blockade on Saudi Arabia.

changes.title: Coveted U.S. Nuclear Deal Is a Coup for Saudi Crown Prince
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia has for years sought a deal to obtain American nuclear technology. The agreement, signed on Wednesday, could deepen U.S.-Saudi ties for decades to come.

changes.title: See How Houthis Put the Red Sea at Risk as an Alternative Oil Route
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia has diverted huge amounts of oil to the Red Sea since the Iran war began, but now the Iranian-backed Houthi militants say that they intend to block that route.
